title: The Alphabet, Words and Numbers
_source: English for Today, Class Two (NCTB). Unit 2, book pages 6-30.
_note: Words and rhymes are transcribed from the textbook. Bangla meanings are Pickixo's addition - the book carries no glosses. Numbers 11-30 appear in the book as figures only, so no English spelling is claimed for them.

lessons.title: Rhyme - Little seed
lessons.objective: Say the rhyme and tell how a plant grows.
lessons.objectiveBn: ছড়া বলা আর গাছ কীভাবে বড় হয় তা বলা।

vocabulary.example: Out comes the sun, big and round.
Down come the rain drops, soft and slow.
Up comes a flower, grow, grow, grow!

steps.title: How a plant grows
steps.say: A seed grows into a flower.

rounds.ask: What comes out big and round?
rounds.askBn: বড় আর গোল হয়ে কী ওঠে?
rounds.speak: Out comes the sun, big and round.
rounds.hint: It is in the sky by day.

questions.explain: The rhyme says: I plant a little seed.

questions.ask: A flower comes up at the end.
questions.explain: Up comes a flower, grow, grow, grow!

steps.title: Lovely rhyme!
steps.say: You know how a plant grows!
steps.sayBn: গাছ কীভাবে বড় হয় তুমি জানো!
